tool_args.rationale: The high-gradient probe reveals the predicted supercritical collapse. Fit the documented thresholded siphon law numerically and test it on fresh confirmation data.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The high-gradient observations fall sharply and become negative, inconsistent with the pilot's smooth saturation alone.
The acquired batch provides three supercritical measurements and five subcritical measurements, enough to fit the documented five-parameter avalanche law.
The observed abrupt high-gradient decline supports the explicitly documented threshold mechanism instead.
